title: Is SOLIDWORKS Free for Students? Free Design Standard, $60 Premium and Other Routes (2026)
summary: Yes: SOLIDWORKS Design Standard for Students is free, India included. Design Premium is USD 60/year. Sign-up steps, licence rules and 2026 system requirements.
body_markdown:
## Is SOLIDWORKS free for students?


**Yes, the basic desktop version is.** SOLIDWORKS Design Standard for Students is free for any enrolled student, India included, and covers 3D part, assembly and drawing work on a Windows PC. Simulation, flow, rendering and CAM come in Design Premium for Students at **USD 60 a year** . Your college licence or a student team sponsorship can also give you SOLIDWORKS free.


All terms below were checked on Dassault Systèmes' SOLIDWORKS pages on **17 November 2026** . The free Design Standard offer launched worldwide in July 2026, so many older articles still say SOLIDWORKS always costs money for students.


## What are the SOLIDWORKS student options?


The[SOLIDWORKS for Students page](https://www.solidworks.com/product/students) (updated 14 Oct 2026) lists three packages:


Package Price (USA list) What you get Runs on


**Design Standard for Students** **Free** 3D CAD (parts, assemblies, drawings), local storage, learning content Windows PC, installed


**Design Premium for Students** USD 60/year Everything above + simulation (structure, flow, plastics), photorealistic rendering, 2.5 and 3-axis CAM, free CSWA and CSWP certification exams ("$198 value") Windows PC, installed


**xDesign for Students** USD 60/year Browser-based SOLIDWORKS Chromebook, Mac, tablet, Windows


Prices are the USA list price; SOLIDWORKS says local pricing is shown in the cart, so Indian students see their own price at checkout.


## How do you get SOLIDWORKS free as an Indian student?


- Open the[Design Standard for Students sign-up form](https://www.solidworks.com/product/students/design-standard-form) . India is in the country list.
- Fill in your details. You qualify if you are "currently enrolled in a formal educational institution at the secondary or post-secondary level". You must be 18+, or 13-17 with a parent involved.
- Follow the emailed link to download, then install on a Windows 11 PC.

- **Your college's licence (Student Access).** If your college holds a SOLIDWORKS institution licence, you "may qualify for... a full license on your own device, at no extra cost". Ask your CAD lab in-charge.
- **Student team sponsorship.** SOLIDWORKS says it "is FREE for Student teams". Formula Student, SAE BAJA, robotics and rocketry teams can[apply](https://discover.solidworks.com/student-teams-free-sponsorship) for desktop or cloud licences. The applicant must be 18 or older.


## Free Design Standard vs USD 60 Design Premium: which do you need?


**For CAD alone, Design Standard is enough.** Sketching, part features, assemblies and 2D drawings are what first- and second-year design courses and most mini projects need.


**Pay for Design Premium when you need analysis.** If your project needs a stress check, a flow study, a rendered image for a report or toolpaths for a CNC machine, Premium adds those. It also includes the CSWA and CSWP certification exams, which you can list on your CV. Buy it for the year you need it, not on day one.


## Can you use the free student version for commercial work?


**No.** The sign-up terms say the software is "provided solely for educational use", with "certain features" that make it "unsuitable for commercial or research purposes". Coursework, self-learning and student projects are fine. Freelance design work or company work during an internship is not; the company must provide a commercial licence.


If you design and sell your own products, SOLIDWORKS has a separate **Makers** licence: USD 48 a year (a promotional USD 24/year offer was shown on 17 Nov 2026) for personal use, while sales stay under USD 2,000 a year. Files made with it are digitally watermarked. In India, Makers subscriptions do not renew automatically.
